The '''Restuss Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Restuss]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It was destroyed in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] during the [[Battle of Restuss]].
